description: React component for managing system role users in Mattermost admin console, including listing, searching, pagination, and adding/removing users from roles.

classes.name: SystemRoleUsers
classes.description: React component class for displaying and managing users assigned to a system role, with search, pagination, and user modification functionalities.

methods.name: componentDidMount
methods.description: Initial data fetch for profiles and user stats when component mounts.

methods.name: componentDidUpdate
methods.description: Handles search term changes with debounce to update user profiles.

methods.name: getVisibleTotalCount
methods.description: Calculates total user count considering additions and removals.

methods.name: getPaginationProps
methods.description: Calculates pagination start, end, and total counts.

methods.name: onSearch
methods.description: Updates search term in parent component.

methods.name: getRows
methods.description: Generates data grid rows based on current users, additions, and removals.

methods.name: getColumns
methods.description: Defines columns for the data grid.

methods.name: onAddCallback
methods.description: Handles adding users to the role.

methods.name: onRemoveCallback
methods.description: Handles removing users from the role.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the admin panel with user list and controls.
